reason: The README describes a DSH plugin primarily for cross-session archiving, review, retrieval, summarization, timeline visualization, and report export, with live status tracking and session metadata management.

summaries.zh: 用于归档、检索和回顾 DSH 会话，提供可折叠时间线、跨会话搜索、摘要、血缘查看、实时状态跟踪与 ZIP 报告导出。
summaries.en: A DSH session archiving and review plugin with foldable timelines, cross-session search, summaries, lineage views, live status tracking, and ZIP report export.

capabilities: Reads and indexes DSH session records for review and search
Provides cross-session full-text search and timeline navigation
Generates rule-based and LLM-assisted session summaries
Exports session overviews and timelines as ZIP archives containing Markdown reports
Polls running sessions every three seconds for live status updates
Renames session titles and manages local index and timeline caches
